pages.text: What a Wild Mage becomes when the rite of overgrowth has steeped it to the marrow: no longer content to grow vines, it holds all the magic of the wild - it casts overgrowth spells, hurls wild bolts, and tangles anything that comes near its master.

Its moves match the hostile version, cycling by priority: seven quick vines and a wild mage, a ring of poison quills, a buried mine or a blossoming orb, a greater summon, a heal, an inspiring cry, and only then a bolt of venom. In water the whole set becomes its aquatic variant. Poison and acid cannot touch it, and it never counts wild kin as targets.
